claim: EV002 and EV003 never see the repo's actual per-test effectful-layer rebuilds. provideScopedLayer and local Layer.build plus Effect.provide helpers are not withXyz wrappers, and the Effect.provide/Effect.scoped calls live in the helper rather than in the it.effect body, so D14's mechanical net misses the pattern SPEC 1.5 names for migration.
evidence: packages/tooling/test-kit/test-utils/src/Layer.ts:34-37 defines provideScopedLayer as Effect.scoped(Layer.build(layer).pipe(Effect.flatMap((context) => effect.pipe(Effect.provide(context))))). JSDoc at Layer.ts:15-16 calls this the test-friendly counterpart to Effect.provide for allocating layers. Detector EV002 (packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:384-408) requires a lexical Effect.provide inside an effect/live callback whose last argument is not Layer.succeed/mock or Context.make/empty/add/merge. EV003 (411-431, 530-532 in the same file) requires a with[A-Z] name plus acquireRelease/Layer.scoped|effect|unwrap|launch in that function. Counterexamples: apps/practice-kg-mcp/test/Host.test.ts:48 and :62 (Effect.fnUntraced(..., provideScopedLayer(TestServices)) where TestServices is BunFileSystem.layer); packages/documents/server/test/DocumentIntake.test.ts:79 (provideScopedLayer(DocumentsIntakeTestLayer)); apps/architecture-lab-proof/test/ArchitectureLabProof.test.ts:10-18 (local provideScopedLayer(ArchitectureLabServerLive)); packages/tooling/library/qa-capture/test/integration/ClockCorrelator.integration.test.ts:12-22,129; packages/drivers/duckdb/test/DuckDb.service.test.ts:655; packages/drivers/pacer/test/Pacer.test.ts:33-36; packages/foundation/capability/semantic-web/test/IdentityRdfBinding.test.ts:91-94. Predicted detector rows for those provides/scopes: none. Baseline/census EV002 on ArchitectureLabProof is census-only; Host baseline is EV006 only.
proposedFix: Treat provideScopedLayer, Layer.build piped into Effect.provide, and equivalent named helpers as EV002/EV003 (mechanical when the callee is this exported helper or a same-file definition matching that body, judgment when imported and unresolved). Stop documenting provideScopedLayer as the allocating-layer path; the replacement is it.layer plus a per-test inner scope.

claim: Harness classification only accepts imported it/test (and @beep/test-utils/Vitest it). The public rc.112 layer, effect, and live exports are treated as non-harness, so EV001-EV009, EV014, and EV015 skip tests registered through those exports, including inner it.effect callbacks whose tester is the layer() parameter.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestSyntax.ts:300-311 importedHarnessBinding requires binding.imported in {it,test} or instrumented it. classifyHarnessCall/isHarnessMethodCall therefore reject import { layer } from "@effect/vitest". createEffectVitestHarnessIndex in packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestSyntax.ts:590-605 only seeds imported it/test calls, so layer-callback testers never index. packages/tooling/library/ai-metrics/test/file-inventory.test.ts:3,14-16 registers layer(NodeServices.layer)("AI metrics file inventory", (it) => { it.effect(..., () => withTempDirectory(...)) }). Predicted EV014 on line 14: none (not a layer harness call). Predicted EV003 on the three withTempDirectory test-body roots: none (parent it.effect is not classified). Baseline EV003 count is 1 (the local definition at line 7 via sourceFunctionDefinitions), census EV003 count is 3 (the calls). Pinned packages/vitest/src/index.ts:216-226 and 169-174 export layer and effect as first-class APIs; the KG entries id layer and effect exist.
proposedFix: Classify callees imported as layer, effect, or live from @effect/vitest the same way as it.layer / it.effect / it.live, including curried layer(L)(name, cb) and the tester object passed into that callback.

claim: EV014 inverts D14 hook-timeout coverage. Imported or property-access layers, and any identifier without a local Layer.scoped/effect/unwrap initializer, produce no row. Cheap in-memory Layer.unwrap of Ref.make does produce a judgment row. EV002 already marks unresolved identifier provides as judgment; EV014 has no equivalent path.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:134-153 isResourceExpression only matches Layer.scoped|effect|unwrap|launch, Effect.acquireRelease|acquireUseRelease, recursive call arguments, or a same-file identifier initializer. Property access is neither. layerHasTimeout (250-253 in the same file) only inspects args[1] of the it.layer call. EV014 push is 514-518. False negatives: apps/professional-desktop/test/theme-atoms.test.tsx:34 it.layer(ProfessionalStorageLive) with no timeout (census EV014 line 34, baseline none); packages/epistemic/server/test/EpistemicServer.test.ts:26 it.layer(EpistemicServerLive) (census EV014, baseline empty); infra/test/OpenClaw.test.ts:397 it.layer(NodeServices.layer); packages/drivers/pacer/test/Pacer.test.ts:145 it.layer(mockLayer()) (census EV014=14, baseline EV014=0). False positive: packages/epistemic/use-cases/test/ClaimDisposition.test.ts:17-33,73 it.layer(inMemoryClaimDispositions) where the layer is Layer.unwrap(Ref.make([])) then Layer.succeed; baseline EV014 is this cheap in-memory block, not a container/server. Pinned upstream uses it.layer(layer, { timeout: "30 seconds" }) on imported SQL/platform layers (reference-supplement KeyValueStoreTest.ts:6-7, SqlEventLogServerUnencryptedStorageTest.ts:48-51).
proposedFix: Emit EV014 as judgment for any it.layer/layer() first argument that is not a proven Layer.succeed/mock stub, including imported identifiers and property access. Keep timeout detection on the options object of the layer registration call (first curry), not only locally constructed Layer.scoped.

claim: EV008 treats any Effect.sleep or Schedule.spaced/fixed/exponential/recurs under it.effect without TestClock.adjust/setTime in the same callback as a stall. It ignores the pinned TestClock.withLive wait, and it flags a sleep that is the interrupted subject rather than a wait.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:199-202 drivenClock only matches TestClock.adjust|setTime. EV008 at 487-496 in the same file does not consult TestClock.withLive. Detector negative fixture (packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/effect-vitest-detectors.test.ts:101-102) only uses TC.adjust. Pinned live-wait counterexamples: packages/platform/node-shared/test/NodeFileSystem.test.ts:31-33 Effect.sleep("10 millis").pipe(TestClock.withLive, ...) inside startWatch used by it.effect watch tests; reference-supplement packages/effect/test/unstable/persistence/SqlCleanupTest.ts:15-22 Effect.repeat({ schedule: Schedule.spaced(...) }) piped to Effect.timeout and TestClock.withLive. If those calls are inlined in an it.effect callback, EV008 fires. Unique baseline EV008: packages/drivers/duckdb/test/DuckDb.service.test.ts:612-661 it.effect with duckdb.withTransaction(() => Effect.sleep("1 hour")) then Fiber.interrupt; no TestClock.adjust. Adding adjust would complete the sleep and change the interruption assertion. Wall-clock wait in that test is Effect.promise(() => sleep(75)) at 648, which EV008 also does not see.
proposedFix: Treat TestClock.withLive in the same test callback as a live-clock driver (no EV008). Do not emit mechanical EV008 when the sleep/schedule is the argument to Fiber.interrupt, Effect.race, or an equivalent cancellation subject; leave those as flake-lens judgment.

claim: EV010 only matches exact ESM specifiers @effect/platform-bun and @effect/platform-node, plus node:fs, node:fs/promises, and an import declaration whose text contains tmpdir. Subpath platform imports and CommonJS require() are invisible.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:215-220,538-546. collectEffectVitestImports (packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestSyntax.ts:138-174) only reads ImportDeclaration nodes. Counterexample ESM subpath: apps/practice-kg-mcp/test/Host.test.ts:8-9 import * as BunFileSystem from "@effect/platform-bun/BunFileSystem" and BunPath from "@effect/platform-bun/BunPath"; TestServices at line 16 is Layer.mergeAll(BunFileSystem.layer, BunPath.layer). Census EV010 lines 9,9,16; baseline has no EV010. Same pattern in packages/documents/server/test/DocumentIntake.test.ts:11-12. Counterexample CJS: infra/ci-runners/sdks/ghaRunners/test/build.test.js:2-3,21 require("node:fs") and require("node:os") with os.tmpdir(); census EV010=4, baseline empty. The sample was chosen as an in-scope JS non-Effect control; D9 still includes it.
proposedFix: Match @effect/platform-bun, @effect/platform-node, and @effect/platform-node-shared by prefix, including subpaths. For .js/.cjs tests, also match require("node:fs"), require("node:fs/promises"), and require("node:os") uses of tmpdir as EV010 judgment rows.

claim: Membership identity is (ruleId, file, symbol, class, evidence, encounter ordinal). Line and column are excluded. Two identical snippets in one file become #1 and #2 in visit order. Removing the earlier instance renames the later one to #1, so the ratchet can report a resolved finding while the remaining instance silently reuses the old key, and exception preservation follows the wrong row.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/Lint.schemas.ts:1302-1316 makeEffectVitestFindingKey. packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:283-296 assignStableIds increments ordinal by sameFingerprint (ruleId, file, class, evidence, symbol) over A.take(findings, index). makeFinding initially stamps #1 then rewrites the suffix. Concrete pair: apps/professional-desktop/test/chat-ui.test.tsx:226 and :245, both evidence expect(O.isNone(latestTurnError)).toBe(true), ids EV006:...:226:expect@48#1 and EV006:...:245:expect@48#2 in rows-for-samples.json. Fixing line 226 only would reassign line 245 to #1, which equals the previous key for line 226. preserveEffectVitestExceptions (packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestScan.ts:169-197) matches that key.
proposedFix: Put a shift-resistant occurrence discriminator in the membership key that does not depend on earlier siblings, for example a hash of the surrounding test name plus a stable intra-test index, or keep line in the key and accept line-shift churn. Do not use a list-order ordinal of identical fingerprints.

claim: EV009's live-need predicate omits Effect.sleep (the actual live-clock API tests use) and only inspects ArrowFunction/FunctionExpression arguments of it.live, so Effect.fnUntraced bodies are skipped. The focused detector test encodes the first mistake as required behavior.
evidence: liveServiceCall at packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:203-214 matches Clock.currentTimeMillis|currentTimeNanos|sleep, Console.log|error|warn|info, and TestClock.withLive only. EV009 at 497-505 in the same file takes the first arrow/function argument of the it.live call; it does not unwrap Effect.fnUntraced/Effect.gen the way createEffectVitestHarnessIndex in packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestSyntax.ts:577-581 does for other rules. packages/tooling/tool/cli/test/effect-vitest-detectors.test.ts:257-259 asserts it.live("sleep", () => Fx.sleep("1 millis")) is EV009. Dock-shell uses the opposite shape: apps/professional-desktop/test/dock-shell.test.tsx:107-116 it.live(..., Effect.fnUntraced(function* () { ... yield* Effect.sleep("600 millis") })), census EV009 line 107, baseline none. ClockCorrelator.integration.test.ts:95-130 is a genuine live ffmpeg/wall-clock test with no Clock/Console/withLive call; baseline EV009=1, which is a judgment false positive under the same predicate. D7/SPEC EV009 is it.live with no evident live-clock or live-console need; Effect.sleep under it.live is that need.
proposedFix: Count Effect.sleep, Clock.sleep, TestClock.withLive, and obvious live OS/process waits as live evidence. Unwrap one level of Effect.fnUntraced/Effect.gen/pipe when locating the live body, matching the harness index.

claim: EV005 does not recognize Effect.result bound through yield*. assertedOutcome only treats expect wrapping the call, or a VariableDeclaration whose initializer is exactly the call.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:171-190,451-457. apps/practice-kg-mcp/test/Host.test.ts:71-77 const missing = yield* Effect.result(loadPracticeKgBundleContext(bundleDir)); then expect(Result.isFailure(missing)). Initializer is a YieldExpression, so EV005 is not emitted. Census EV005 lines 71 and 74; baseline only EV006 on the expect(Result.isFailure) calls at 76-77. D5 still wants Effect.exit plus assertExit*/assertFailure here.
proposedFix: When Effect.result is yielded into a const/let that an expect/assert in the same test callback then inspects, emit EV005. Keep the existing EV006 row on the hand-rolled Result.isFailure expect, or fold both into one outcome-assertion finding.

claim: EV006 only inspects expect() from vitest/@effect/vitest. Hand-rolled Option/Result/Exit predicates through @effect/vitest/utils assertTrue/assert.isTrue are D5 violations that never become rows.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:166-167,459-472 isExpectCall plus containsDataShape on Option/Result/Exit isSome/isNone/some/none/isSuccess/isFailure/succeed/fail. packages/foundation/capability/semantic-web/test/IdentityRdfBinding.test.ts:104-105 assert.isTrue(Result.isFailure(decoded)) after S.decodeResult; same at 120-121. Baseline EV006 is empty for this file (only EV007). Drizzle.errors.test.ts:42-44 shows the expect(O.isNone(...)) form that is caught (baseline EV006=18). D5 requires assertFailure/assertSuccess/assertNone, not a boolean predicate on the data type.
proposedFix: Treat assertTrue/assertFalse/assert.isTrue/assert.isFalse (utils or Node assert) whose argument is an Option/Result/Exit shape call as EV006, with the matching utils.assert* replacement.

claim: The instrumented runner stores per-property run state in a native Map keyed by object identity. Repo Effect law requires effect/HashMap or MutableHashMap. Behavior of the proven fixtures is unaffected, but the module is otherwise Effect-first.
evidence: packages/tooling/test-kit/test-utils/src/internal/VitestInstrumentation.ts:48-51 TestExecutionState.propertyRuns: Map<object, PropertyRunState>, and 247-258 propertyRunFor uses Map.get/set. aroundEach at 272-275 allocates a new Map per test execution. No HashMap/MutableHashMap import in this file.
proposedFix: Replace the Map with MutableHashMap using a reference-identity key, or a generated trial id, matching the rest of the package.

claim: EV001, EV007, and EV004 only attach when the offending call is lexically inside a harness callback. Same-file helpers that contain Effect.runSync, fc.assert, or Effect.scoped are invisible even when every caller is an it or it.effect test. Census rg still counts those files.
evidence: packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Lint/internal/EffectVitestDetectors.ts:377-383 (EV001 inTest), 432-449 (EV004 effectTest plus isWholeBodyCall), 474-486 (EV007 inTest). enclosingTest walks ancestors and stops at the helper function, not the caller. packages/drivers/duckdb/test/DuckDb.service.test.ts:99-123 encodeSchema and assertSchemaArbitraryRoundTrips contain Effect.runSync and fc.assert; callers are plain it at 126-205. Census EV001=3 and EV007=1, baseline has neither. infra/test/OpenClaw.test.ts:104-114 runCaptured wraps Effect.scoped; the call at 767 is inside it.effect under it.layer(NodeServices.layer), so EV004 is hidden the same way. Detector fixtures only place runSync/assert/scoped directly in the tester callback.
proposedFix: Either attribute inner runSync, fc.assert, and Effect.scoped calls to same-file callers that are harness callbacks, or emit definition-site rows for those helpers the way EV003 already does for withXyz wrappers.

claim: The standalone layer() timeout option is not an EV014 replacement edge. After a harness fix for public layer(), hook-timeout remediation still would not map to that export. TestClock.withLive likewise has replaces [] even though it is the pinned live wait for EV008.
evidence: standards/effect-vitest.primitives.jsonc layer.option.timeout id around 693-708, replaces []. it.layer.option.timeout at 637-653 replaces EV014. TestClock.withLive at 1483-1499, replaces []. readme.testclock at 1227-1243 replaces EV008 and tells readers not to switch to live, with no withLive alternative. packages/tooling/library/ai-metrics/test/file-inventory.test.ts:14 uses layer(NodeServices.layer) with no timeout. Pinned KeyValueStoreTest.ts:6-7 uses it.layer(layer, { timeout }).
proposedFix: Add EV014 to layer.option.timeout replaces (and whenToUse). Add EV008 to TestClock.withLive replaces, or to readme.testclock whenToUse, naming withLive as the live-wait form that is not a stall.
